Meta.Name: [medulla](FBbt_00003748)
Meta.Description:
The second optic neuropil, sandwiched between the lamina and the lobula complex. It is divided into 10 layers: 1-6 make up the outer (distal) medulla, the seventh (or serpentine) layer exhibits a distinct architecture and layers 8-10 make up the inner (proximal) medulla ([Ito et al., 2014](FBrf0224194)).
([Nériec and Desplan, 2016](FBrf0231227), [Ito et al., 2014](FBrf0224194))
Meta.Comment: [Nern et al., 2025](FBrf0262545) - FBrf0262545 say distal is M1-5 and M6-7 is central medulla.
Meta.Relationships: [develops from](RO_0002202): [medulla anlage](FBbt_00001935); [is part of](BFO_0000050): [adult optic lobe](FBbt_00003701)
